Yo.

posts.body2: They're encrypted tight but nothing we can't break.
posts.body3: The first one is a gem. Literally, the beam server has someone on the inside of one of the top American publishers that managed to get it out before release. It's banned here because of the names of space stations, can you beleive that!? It's locked in custom protection. I need eyes on the code.

posts.body1: They say the Castle burned clean,
posts.body2: a perfect white sun swallowing stone,
posts.body3: silk, and every name we were meant to carry.
posts.body5: a quiet man in borrowed robes
posts.body8: I wasn't there. None of us were.
posts.body9: But some nights, when the streetlights hum wrong,
posts.body10: I feel a country I never met breathing through the cracks of this one.
posts.body11: A language I was told to unlearn.
posts.body12: Songs no radio here will play.
posts.body13: A crown that was turned to vapor so another could be hammered into gold leaf.
posts.body14: Maybe the Shogun believed that survival meant surrender.
posts.body15: Maybe he mistook obedience for mercy.
posts.body16: But I've seen what obedience built. Steel cities with American names.
posts.body17: Schools where our ghosts speak English. History written like a wound that never happened.
posts.body18: If the Imperial line had lived, would we still be strangers in our own mirrors?
posts.body19: Would we still dream in the accents of our occupiers?
posts.body20: I don't know. All I know is this: Every night, the Tower broadcasts the world they want us to remember. And every night, I listen for the world we were never allowed to inherit.
